quantification_warning: Source-specific lower bounds only. 22 Hub-A distinct original poster handles each with three required-follow edges; 13 Hub-B distinct original poster handles each with two required-follow edges, with at least one handle overlapping the hubs. These are synthetic graph representations of observed campaign rules, NOT all-post or 30-day interaction frequencies. Repost-event timestamps unavailable for many mirrors. Earlier 6 Percept and 11 Thanefield repost-posts span nonuniform archival snapshots.
privacy: No private messages or private contact identifiers.
verification_rule: For each edge separate observed interaction, commercial/organizational affiliation, and control hypothesis.

extended_sample_notes.unit: one selected indexed origin giveaway per distinct handle; 3 required-follow edges per origin post; not complete event frequency
extended_sample_notes.visible_creator_repost_relationships: Direct reposts and replies among EFE, Emrik, Playmaker, Aeroonfx/mirngaprime, and other creators demonstrate affinity; quantitative rates unavailable.
extended_sample_notes.hubB_warning: 13 originators selected from web-indexed posts; not a census, not events from same known UTC window, not proof of ownership. @EquitySpace1 brand-affinity strong but exact management unknown.
